posts.title: A Recession Run by People Who Stopped Noticing the Price of Bread
posts.description: Go to a grocery store right now and try to fill a cart for a family of four. Watch the total climb past $200 before you’ve even hit the dairy aisle. Then open your phone and scroll through your timeline. A tech CEO is bragging about how many tokens he burned this month. Another is posting a wrist-shot of a $40,000 watch.
